[[Free-to-play|Free]] players can only cut [[tree|regular]], [[oak]], [[willow]], [[teak]], [[Maple Tree|maple]], [[Acadia tree|acadia]], and [[yew]] trees. Previously, the maple trees were [[members]]-only, but the log itself was non-members. The [[Dungeoneering]] update of [[19 July]] [[2010]] designated a [[Daemonheim Peninsula resource dungeon|resource dungeon]] where free players with a Dungeoneering level of 30 could cut them.

* Can be bought from [[Scavvo's Rune Store]] in the [[Champions' Guild]].

For calculating logs and experience per hour, you will also need the delay between attempts. This is {{Ticks|4|long}} for all trees.

===Buffs===

===Tree felling===
After obtaining logs from most trees, there is a chance that the tree will be felled, replacing it with a stump temporarily. These chances are given as an integer representing the chance out of 256 that the tree will fall.

If the tree is going to fall, depletion prevention effects like the [[Refined]] perk will roll, and if successful the tree will be saved.
